title.zh: ⚡️美国众议院监督委员会将预测市场内幕交易调查扩大至Hyperliquid等平台
title.en: ⚡️美国众议院监督委员会将预测市场内幕交易调查扩大至Hyperliquid等平台

current_state.zh: The US House Oversight Committee widened its insider-trading investigation into prediction markets, sending document requests on KYC and suspicious-activity procedures to Hyperliquid Labs, Crypto.com and PredictIt operator Aristotle Exchange.
current_state.en: The US House Oversight Committee widened its insider-trading investigation into prediction markets, sending document requests on KYC and suspicious-activity procedures to Hyperliquid Labs, Crypto.com and PredictIt operator Aristotle Exchange.
